story.title: Final Pummel
story.blurb: Out of fuel and adrift in deep space, the Vortox Pummelers are boarded by the Llamanians who have hunted Emmett for years, as the crew's longest mission nears its end.

lines.text: There is a certain special quality of life when you are close to people who love you. These people make life worth living, and act as a sanctuary; a protection from the adverse outside forces that try to tear you apart. From humble beginnings, an elf, a plant, a poltergeist, and an arsonist worked together to make their way in the universe, doing odd jobs and completing missions. What kept them the closest together, however, was their harboring of the galaxy's most targeted prisoner: a goat. While this goat was not particularly special, he had the special statistic of being the last known member of his species. This kid underwent many ups and downs, fighting for his survival against assassination and ignorance. Now, however, lies the end of their combined journey, a matter of life or death.

On the planet of Vega-5, the Vortox Pummelers vacationed with great goals in mind. While they were there to relax, Garrick and Sanya pushed for an intervention for Emmett, wanting to explain to him how he needed to stay strong in his fight against grass. There were no real plans for the other crew members, but Garrick mentioned that he wanted them to have a "Grand ol' summer of sixty-nine", whatever that meant. At least Seth understood, anyhow, as he motioned the others over to the lazy river to relax.

PURPOSE

The Galactic Union (GU) Research, Statistics, Journalism, Education, and Neuroscience Organization (RSJENO) base houses sensitive information on the latest GU scientific developments. Of course, the Galactic Union is always ahead in its technology and its future planning. Insider knowledge is pivotal for gaining the upper hand. There is no chance of a successful upheaval unless we know what they know.

OVERVIEW

The mission was an overwhelming success. The target location was overtaken in approximately two periods (hours), forty-six unions (minutes), and sixty-one duons (seconds). There were no casualties.

The FINAL PUMMEL squadron entered at 17:34:52 and began the attack. Security was low as expected. The team split into three groups of two with Dreadflower on her own. Im'Kin'ki and Chomsky ambushed the main admin quarters. Garrick and Constantini entered communications and secured the operatives there. Bellatoria and Vatssel shut off power for all pods and docked ships. Dreadflower terminated the security and, despite being alone, held off all defense troops on her own. When LA backup arrived, it was a matter of minutes before the base was entirely secured and the FINAL PUMMEL team retreated.

There was only minor damage to three operatives, all treated on the return flight. Anonymity was kept intact for all recruits, with the exception of Dreadflower, who, after eliminating a fleet of soldiers, removed her helmet to eat the remains while in a “Floran rage state,” as described by Garrick. It is currently unknown if Dreadflower was identified by GU surveillance, but for now, she will remain under Llamanian protection.

The RSJENO base is currently under the supervision of General Llod. All divisions are under Llamanian Armada control. The ports and docking areas have been blocked off to avoid intrusion. All defense systems are reconfigured to eliminate any unsigned ships that approach the outpost.
